turns.proseText: You Let's play pontoon. pontoon You have a king and a nine, 19 in total. Both dealer cards are face-down. Twist, stick, or buy? You Twist. Twist gives you a two of hearts. Your hand is king, nine, two, which is 21. Any further card would bust you, so stick. You Stick. Dealer shows a queen and a five for 15, so dealer sticks. Your 21 beats it, and you win 100 chips. Your ace and four make a soft 15. You can stick on 15, twist for another card, or buy for a face-down card at double stake. You Buy a card. You bought a card for another 100 chips. The stake is now 200, and the card is face down. Your hand is ace and four plus the hidden card, which makes soft 18. Twist, stick, or buy again? You Stick. Dealer had 14 and had to draw, so the dealer took a five of hearts for 19. Your 18 loses to 19, and you lose your 200-chip stake. Bet of 50 placed. Dealing now. You Stick.
